ruleset.name: COMP 2522 sample code
ruleset.description:
The same two PMD categories your labs are checked against, with one rule removed.
SystemPrintln reports every call to System.out.println. That rule is correct advice for production software, where output belongs in a logging framework. It is wrong advice here: printing is how a lecture sample shows you what it did, so essentially every file in this repository would be reported. When 71% of a report is noise you stop reading the report, and the report is the point.
The rule is still active in your lab builds. Nothing else is removed.
